title: Bound rounded native-line defects for the zero-retention QQ16 decoder
body:
## Summary

```diff
 PR2707's 336 signed native lines / PR2736's error contract
- abstract completed-line relative-defect premise
+ direct rounded pair implementation with explicit monomial wrappers
+ all-depth error <= lambda * sqrt(D/2) * delta
+ block scaling meeting u = 2^(-b-22), with direct-work costs stated
```

Adds only `research/qq16-rounded-native-line/`. This takes the rounded-line obligation in [the PR2736 handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2727), as a local reference implementation rather than a recursively cheap child. It also gives a fixed-grid counterexample to inferring relative accuracy without scale control.

The direct algorithm requires a component scan, 4*lambda*D real ADD/subtracts, rounding, explicit permutations and owner-local exponent metadata. **It does not inherit the rank-one recursive price.** Cheap child realization, finite formats, entry norms, complete caller/consumer costs and supplier admission remain open. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

Exact predecessors are ywz65's PR2707 `efa51a6c7ffec6edd556a98deedfe9deeba65809` and PR2736 `eba0d6111a773cd13f5c0afb4354af2c85d04c3a`. Credit Arham Tahir's PR2681, PR2540, Ali Romman and the retained QQ16/native lineage. Source proofs and notices are preserved byte-exactly. Their ideal native/frame theorem is inherited, not recertified.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR2736 explicitly leaves internal component rounding open. A one-factor line on the smallest fixed-grid input can round to zero with relative error one.
  **After:** the written all-depth proof and exact-rational implementation supply one sufficient block-scaled line contract. A separately implemented dense kernel checks 1,240 signed basis columns; 72 absolute and 72 relative tensor cases pass. Every relative case has nonzero rounding error, including the consumed 22-bit guard.
- CPython 3.12.15 on Linux x86_64: normal/optimized registered replay, 13 semantic/boundary controls, four CLI artifact groups, all 74 research-workflow tests, Ruff lint/format and selected baseline bindings pass. Source corruption, typed receipt corruption, overwrite refusal and Git-free read-only export are exercised.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -I -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/qq16-rounded-native-line
```

Started from canonical main `8e22a9d9f`, priority revision 5. Pre-submission main `31452ecd3` has unchanged guidance, selected record, runner and consumed PR heads; the virtual merge is clean. Final overlap covers 716 open PRs and 1,407 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings. Coverage does not include arbitrary diffs or unpublished work. No formal-kernel, physical-machine, selected cold-replay or hosted-CI pass is claimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

One opt-in package. Existing verifiers, frozen predecessors and selected records are unchanged.
